remarks: Welcome to your ultimate coastal oasis! Nestled within a highly desirable, relaxing beach community with access to a private beach association, this stunning 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom home perfectly balances luxury, entertainment, and eco-friendly, low-cost living. Step inside to experience an abundance of amazing natural sunshine that floods the spacious, airy layout. Designed for seamless everyday living and effortless hosting, the heart of the home flows beautifully between comfortable relaxation areas and vibrant entertaining spaces. For ultimate convenience and longevity, the main level features a luxurious first-floor primary suite-your own private retreat complete with an ensuite bath. Outdoor living is a dream come true. The beautifully manicured, perfectly fenced-in backyard offers a private, secure sanctuary for weekend gatherings. Whether you are hosting a summer barbecue or unwinding after a day at the private beach, this manicured exterior backdrop is ready for memories. What truly sets this property apart is its incredible efficiency. Equipped with fully owned solar panels, this home offers incredibly low-cost living by drastically reducing your monthly energy footprints and utility bills from day one. Enjoy the absolute best of coastal neighborhood charm, private beach perks, and sustainable modern upgrades all in one turnkey package. Your perfect lifestyle awaits!
